about.title: About Us
about.metaDescription: Discover Enouza luxury lamps, designer lighting, and premium indoor lamps. Elevate your home with high-end modern floor lamps, elegant table lamps, and handcrafted decorative lighting.
about.intro: At Enouza, we believe lighting is more than illumination — it’s an experience.
about.passion: Our passion is creating spaces that feel warm, refined, and timeless. That’s why we carefully curate luxury lamps that combine modern design, premium materials, and exceptional craftsmanship. Every piece in our collection is chosen to elevate your home, not just light it.
about.visionText: We aim to redefine everyday lighting by offering statement pieces that bring elegance, comfort, and character into any room. From cozy bedrooms to sophisticated living spaces, our lamps are designed to transform atmospheres.
about.qualityText: We work closely with trusted manufacturers and designers who share our commitment to quality. Each lamp is selected for its durability, aesthetic value, and attention to detail — because luxury should be felt, not just seen.
about.modernText: Our collection blends contemporary trends with classic elegance, making our lamps perfect for modern homes, apartments, and luxury interiors. Whether you’re looking for a statement floor lamp or a subtle ambient glow, Enouza brings light that reflects your style.
about.closing: Thank you for choosing Enouza — where light meets luxury.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Enouza.com (the “Site” or “we”) collects, uses, and discloses your Personal Information when you visit or make a purchase from the Site.

collectingPersonalInfo.title: Collecting Personal Information
collectingPersonalInfo.description: When you visit the Site, we collect certain information about your device, your interaction with the Site, and the information necessary to process your purchases. We may also collect additional information if you contact us for customer support. In this Privacy Policy, we refer to any information that can uniquely identify an individual (including the information below) as 'Personal Information'.

deviceInfo.title: Device Information
deviceInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: web browser version, IP address, time zone, cookie information, sites or products you view, search terms, and how you interact with the Site.
deviceInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to load the Site accurately for you and to perform analytics on Site usage to optimize our Site.
deviceInfo.source: Source of collection: Collected automatically when you access our Site using cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, or pixels.
deviceInfo.disclosure: Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Enouza.

orderInfo.title: Order Information
orderInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information, email address, and phone number.
orderInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to provide products or services to you, process payment information, arrange shipping, provide invoices or order confirmations, communicate with you, screen orders for risk or fraud, and provide advertising or information in line with your preferences.
orderInfo.source: Source of collection: collected from you.
orderInfo.disclosure: Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Enouza.

customerSupportInfo.title: Customer Support Information
customerSupportInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information, email address, and phone number.
customerSupportInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to provide customer support.
customerSupportInfo.source: Source of collection: collected from you.

sharingPersonalInfo.title: Sharing Personal Information
sharingPersonalInfo.text: We share your Personal Information with service providers to help us provide our services and fulfill our contracts with you, as described above. For example, we may share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, respond to subpoenas, search warrants, or other lawful requests, or to otherwise protect our rights.

behavioralAdvertising.title: Behavioral Advertising
behavioralAdvertising.text: We use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. For example, we use Google Analytics to understand how customers use the Site. More about Google's use of Personal Information: https://policies.google.com/privacy. Opt-out: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. We also share information about your use of the Site and ads with advertising partners.

usingPersonalInfo.title: Using Personal Information
usingPersonalInfo.text: We use your Personal Information to provide our services, including offering products for sale, processing payments, shipping and fulfilling orders, and keeping you updated on new products, services, and offers.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis
lawfulBasis.text: If you are a resident of the EEA, we process your personal information under the following lawful bases: your consent, performance of a contract, legal obligations, vital interests, public interest tasks, or legitimate interests not overriding your fundamental rights.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: When you place an order through the Site, we retain your Personal Information unless and until you ask us to erase it.

automaticDecisionMaking.title: Automatic Decision-Making
automaticDecisionMaking.text: If you are an EEA resident, you have the right to object to automated decision-making (including profiling) with legal or significant effect. Our processor uses limited automated decisions to prevent fraud, such as temporary deny lists for IPs or credit cards.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.gdpr: EEA residents have the right to access, port, correct, update, or erase their Personal Information. Contact us to exercise these rights.
yourRights.ccpa: California residents have the right to access ('Right to Know'), port, correct, update, or erase their Personal Information. You may designate an authorized agent to submit requests.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: Cookies are small pieces of information downloaded to your device when visiting our Site. We use functional, performance, advertising, and social media cookies to enhance your browsing experience and remember preferences.

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track
doNotTrack.text: Since there is no consistent industry response to 'Do Not Track' signals, we do not alter our data collection practices if such a signal is detected in your browser.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in practices or for legal, regulatory, or operational reasons.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For more information about our privacy practices, questions, or complaints, contact us via email at hello@enouza.com.

returns.heading: Returns:
returns.text: Simply put, you can return merchandise for a refund ONLY if the item is in BRAND NEW, UNOPENED CONDITION, including its original packaging and accessories. We know this seems a little extreme, but without this stipulation, we would not be able to offer our amazing prices. We will honor refunds for unopened items up until 15 - 25 days from when you have received your product. All refunds will be issued back to your original payment method and can take up to 7-10 business days to apply.

rejectedRefunds.heading: Your refund will be rejected if your items are returned due to the following issues:
items: If you want to return your product due to damage to the item’s original box.
If the product you returned has been opened and unsealed.
Items with minor cosmetic paint problems for prize figures as these are expected.

exceptions.heading: Exceptions / Non-Returnable items:
exceptions.text: Pre-orders are final sales and are non-returnable once shipped. If you receive a defective product, please contact us for information on contacting the manufacturer. Items with box imperfections and general flaws. Please contact us if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

returnShipping.heading: Return Shipping:
returnShipping.text: To return a product, please contact our customer support with your order number and reason for return. You will be provided with a return label if your return request is approved.

damagesIssues.heading: Damages and Issues
damagesIssues.text: Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you received the wrong item so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

refunds.heading: Refunds
refunds.text: We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund.

paragraphe: If you’re looking to return your order for whatever reason, we're here to help with no hassle! We offer returns within 30 days of purchase. You can return your product for a refund to the original payment method if the product did not meet your expectations. The refund will be processed back to its original form of payment within 5-10 business days.
list: Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
Returned items must include identifying information and be returned in the original product packaging.
Returned items must have no visible signs of wear or use.
The shipping cost will not be refunded unless you were sent a wrong or damaged item.
A prepaid return label will not be provided unless the wrong item was sent, or the item was damaged in transit.

We do not process apparel exchanges. If the item you purchased doesn't fit, please return it for a refund. You may then place a new order for your desired size. For more information and RMA labels, please contact our Customer Service Team.

returnFaq.question: How do you return a product?

list: Log in to your Enouza account and contact our Customer Service Team.
Provide as much information as possible about the products you wish to return or exchange from your order.
Returned items must have no visible signs of wear or use.
Print the prepaid shipping label that you will receive by email.
Please note that a prepaid return label will not be provided unless the wrong item was sent, or the item was damaged in transit.
Send all items back to us using the label provided.

returnFaq.question: My product arrived damaged! What should I do?

paragraphe: Sorry collectors! We understand how disappointing it is to receive a damaged item - especially an item you have waited months for! Unfortunately, mistakes happen and products may get damaged during transit. In the event that this happens, please contact us with pictures of the damaged item and we will replace or issue a partial or full refund. Your satisfaction is our #1 priority!

returnFaq.question: What products are excluded from the return policy?

list: Digital products, including memberships and gift cards, are not eligible for refunds or returns. If you experience any issue accessing or using a digital product, please contact us and we will be happy to assist you.
Products purchased as part of clearance or final-sale promotions may not be eligible for return, except where required by law.
Products that have been used, installed, or modified after delivery may not be eligible for return, depending on the condition of the product and our return policy.
If your product arrives damaged or has a defect, please contact us as soon as possible so we can assist you and find an appropriate solution.
Additional conditions may apply to certain products and will be indicated on the relevant product page where applicable.

returnFaq.question: My product has a defect / missing parts. What should I do?

paragraphe: Contact us directly with pictures and explanation of the defect.
Please note: home video products are not guaranteed to come with a slipcover.

list: After an order is cancelled or a return is processed, your refund will be issued to its original form of payment.

shippingFaq.question: What happens if my package is lost in transit?

paragraphe: If a package is shown as delivered but you have not received it, please contact the carrier and notify us within 30 days of the delivery date.
If it is determined that the package was lost due to a delivery error by the carrier, we will replace your order.

If the package is lost due to an incomplete or incorrect address, we cannot offer a refund or exchange—customers are responsible for ensuring their shipping address is correct at the time of purchase. If the package is returned to us, you will need to pay an additional shipping fee for resending it.
If you find that your shipping address is incorrect or has changed since placing your order, please notify us with your order number/ID and the updated address.
Your order will be processed during normal business days (Monday to Friday, excluding holidays).

If an item is in stock, your order will be processed within 1 to 5 business days. Delivery time after processing will vary based on the shipping address. Currently, delivery times range between 5 to 15 business days.
Once an item ships, you will receive an email with tracking information. In some special cases, tracking numbers may not be available.

shippingFaq.question: Will I receive my order in multiple packages?

paragraphe: If you purchase in-stock items shipped from different warehouses, you will receive multiple shipments.
Shipping charges are calculated during checkout. You can add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, and enter your shipping address to see the shipping cost for your order.
